Title: Source 4: Zydeco Musicians (1938)
Content: `text(Two)` zydeco musicians play their instruments in front of a store near New Iberia, Louisiana. The man on the left plays an accordion. The other man plays a washboard. These `text(two)` instruments are important in zydeco music. Zydeco originated in Louisiana. It blends blues, rhythm and blues, and Creole music.
